forensics_metadata.title: Floor Guard AI — Video Detection Failure Forensics

failure_analysis_table.actual_visible_scene: Overturned jar on floor with liquid spill spread and shattered glass shards
failure_analysis_table.root_cause: Border rejection filter (is_border=True) pruned box touching frame boundary; high min threshold (0.30) rejected partial liquid reflections; defaulted to Clean Floor.

failure_analysis_table.actual_visible_scene: Broken, cracked concrete slab and fractured floor tile crater
failure_analysis_table.root_cause: Legacy 10-class taxonomy lacked floor_damage class; detector forced crack shadow contour into water_spill puddle class.

failure_analysis_table.actual_visible_scene: Curled commercial entrance mat corner and raised runner tripping lip
failure_analysis_table.root_cause: Legacy taxonomy lacked floor_mat_hazard class; raised mat contour misattributed to liquid pooling perimeter.

failure_analysis_table.actual_visible_scene: Wet liquid sheen with yellow caution cone in background
failure_analysis_table.root_cause: Correctly identified liquid specular reflectance glints and wet floor geometry.

failure_analysis_table.actual_visible_scene: Completely dry normal polished floor with yellow cone outside spill area
failure_analysis_table.root_cause: Yellow caution cone reflection on dry tile triggered high-saturation rule in broken glass / chemical spill classifier.

failure_analysis_table.actual_visible_scene: Multiple black and grey electrical extension cables tangled across pedestrian aisle
failure_analysis_table.root_cause: Cable wire Hough line threshold was too strict (minLineLength=35px), thin cords below 40px bounding box dimension were pruned by noise filter.

failure_analysis_table.actual_visible_scene: Cardboard packing boxes and crate blocking central warehouse walkway
failure_analysis_table.root_cause: Box touched outer frame margin; is_border check discarded candidate box before NMS.

failure_analysis_table.actual_visible_scene: Repeated walkthrough of previous zones with slight camera pan
failure_analysis_table.expected_ground_truth: Consolidated Persistent Events without redundant duplicates
failure_analysis_table.previous_model_output: Spammed new incidents on every single frame sample
failure_analysis_table.root_cause: Fixed 8-segment sampling without spatio-temporal IoU continuity tracking created duplicate alerts for identical spatial hazards.

synchronization_forensics.issue: Keyframe thumbnail and video player timestamp discrepancy
synchronization_forensics.mechanism: Keyframe extraction sampled frame at mid_sec of time segment, but recorded seekTime at start_sec. User clicking keyframe sought to start_sec (showing different visual content) instead of mid_sec frame.
synchronization_forensics.resolution: Explicitly enforce keyframe.seekTime == (keyframe.frame / fps) with synchronized timestamp labeling.
